name: @zapwebp/plugin-sdk
description: The Zapwebp Plugin Development Kit. Defines contracts, lifecycle hooks, and adapters for formats, storage, cropping, and transforms.

interfaces.name: ZapwebpPlugin
interfaces.description: Standard plugin container declaring metadata, lifecycle hooks, storage adapters, and agent metadata.

beforeConvert.description: Pre-conversion hook to mutate input, options, or inspect metadata.

afterConvert.description: Post-conversion hook to inspect or mutate output artifacts.

adapters.description: Named storage adapters (e.g., supabase, firebase, neocities).

interfaces.name: FormatHandler
interfaces.description: Contract for adding custom input or output image container formats (e.g. HEIC, WebP2, JXL).

interfaces.name: StorageAdapter
interfaces.description: Interface for cloud and filesystem persistence with cascading deletion support.

examples.name: Define a custom format plugin
